main_text.p: Plural. שְׁפָלִים Humiles, Job.5.11. Fœmin. מַמְלָכָה שְׁפָלָה Regnum humile, Ezech.17.14. וּשְׁפָלָה Et depressior, Lev.13. v.21. Constr. שִׁפְלַת קוֹמָה Humilis statura, Ezech.17.6. Chald. וּשְׁפַל אֲנָשִׁים Et abjectissimum, humilimum virorum, Dan.4.14.
שְׁפַל m. Abjectio, Eccles.10.6. Aff. שֶׁבִּשְׁפָלֵנוּ Qui in abjectione nostra, Psal.136.23.
שִׁפְלָה masc. Planicies, Humilis, Depressus locus, Jos.11.16. Aff. וּשְׁפָלְתָּה Et planitiem ejus, Ibid.
שָׁפָם m. Mystax: Levit.13.45. Ezech.24.22. Aff. וְלֹא עָשָׂה שָׂפָמוֹ Neq3 aptaverat mystacem suum, 2.Sam.19.24.
שָׁפָן m. Cuniculus, vel juxta alios, Mus montanus, Proverb.30.26.
שָׁפַע m. Affluentia, Abundantia: שֶׁפַע יָמִים יִינְקוּ Affluentium marium sugent, Deuter.33.19. Chaldæum est, & Verbum שפע Redundare: Unde, חֲמָרָה נִשְׁפָּעַן Vino redundabant, Prov.3.10.
שִׁפְעָה f. Agmen, Affluentia: Constr. אֶת־שִׁפְעַת יְהוּא Agmen Jehu, 2.Reg.9.17. וּשְׁפַעַת־מָיִם Et affluentia sive inundatio aquarum, Job.22.11.

שָׁפָף שְׁפִיפוֹן m. Cerastes: vel ut alii, Serpens jaculus, Genes.49.17. Kimchi in Michlol refert ad שפה ; per geminationem media radicalis, ut צָלִיל ‧ הַגִּיג . Sic diceretur, quod excelso loco præceps, jaculi instar, feratur. Jaculi serpentis meminit Plinius lib.8. cap.23.
* שָׁפָךְ Quæ hinc esse possint, vide in סָפַךְ .
שָׁפֶר Decorum, Elegans, Pulchrum esse: Præter. שָׁפְרָה Elegantissima est, Psalm.16.6. Chald. Præter.

page.notes: Hebrew vowel points and consonants are transcribed as seen at the scan resolution; points on the headwords and the smaller Hebrew glosses are uncertain and not checked against a reference. "Neq3" is printed as such; the sign after the q is uncertain. Large headword letters are read as the Hebrew root forms they most likely stand for. Long s is rendered as plain s (e.g. "Eccles.", "Jesa.", "Demissio", "Depressio", "Mystax", "Genes.", "esse") in line with the transcription rules; the scan shows long f-shaped s throughout. The entry "שָׁפָף שְׁפִיפוֹן" has an uncertain headword; the printed root heading may read differently.
